_comment: Mama's Perspective — the property's open ground-truth questions, the kind only someone standing on the land can settle. Fetched at load by viewer.html (NOT inlined — no _DATA const, so check-data-inline.py does not track it; a failed fetch just means an absent queue, which is the correct calm behavior). This is a QUEUE, navigable and continuously populatable: Paul adds rows over time, refines them on what Mom engages with, and it is deliberately NOT one-and-done. Framing is Mom <-> app direct (her space to record her read of the place) — do NOT foreground Paul in prompts or acks. Mom's answers land via POST /api/feedback with context.{type:'mom-queue',questionId,kind}; Paul reads them with tools/read-mom-feedback.py, acts on the answer (edit plants.json, flip confidence inferred->verified), and sets the row active:false (or deletes it). Schema is forward-compatible: kind = confirm|react|open, answerMode = yesno|sentiment|text. v1 (2026-07-13) seeds confirm items + one standing open foot-line.

questions.prompt: Down in the fairway and meadow there seem to be **two different grasses** — a coarse clumpy one and a lower, spreading one. We're guessing the spreading one might be crabgrass, but that's only a guess from a picture. **Does that low spreading grass have little finger-like seed spikes on it now?** That would tell us for sure.
questions._draftNote: DRAFT staged 2026-07-20 for the FUTURE ping (Paul: onus on Mom to confirm the grass ID with her own pictures down the road). Seasonal — best served in August when seed-heads emerge. ⚠️ The add-a-photo-on-card idea this note used to point at was KILLED (BACKLOG: 'adds a sixth input affordance to the surface we are disambiguating') — do not revive it from here. 2026-08-08 (Paul-approved, both edits): the ask was written on 07-20 as a FUTURE ping and still said 'Come late summer' — it IS late summer, so it now asks in the present; and `later` was the last card anywhere still carrying 'I haven't looked' against the 07-31 ratification of 'Snooze card'. That label is the monitored variable under WATCH, and serving two wordings at once would have pooled two treatments in one queue — the exact comparison the WATCH row says not to make. 2026-08-10: SERVED WITH NO PHOTO — `check-cards.py` flagged it, and the flag was right: the card names two grasses, asks about one, and asks her to judge a feature (digitate seed spikes) with nothing on screen showing what one looks like. Fixed with a CARD-LEVEL `photo`/`attribution` — a new slot, because the card's need and the entity's lead image are genuinely different pictures: `fairway-meadow` wants a meadow, `crabgrass` (now photographed, it was the only weed without one) wants its spreading habit, and THIS card wants the seed-head alone. Deliberately NOT the killed add-a-photo-on-card idea — that was an INPUT affordance for Mom; this is display-only, nothing new to tap. Reference image, captioned 'not one taken here' by the existing honest-provenance predicate; Paul's own 7/20 walk photos of the fairway grasses are not in the repo.

questions.prompt: You said .14 inches over seven days didn't look right — and you were right. That number reset every Sunday, so it was never really the last seven days. It's a true rolling week now, with each day listed separately. **Do the daily numbers look closer to the rain you actually got?**
questions.correctionPrompt: About how much do you think fell? (optional)
questions._note: STAGED 2026-08-27, active:false — Paul's gate not yet passed. ORIGIN: her own note of 2026-07-26, the only correctness challenge she has ever made — she disbelieved .14in over seven days and asked to see rainfall by day. The by-day strip shipped from it (viewer.html .rain-byday-hdr) and SHE WAS NEVER TOLD WHETHER SHE WAS RIGHT. This closes that loop. ⚠ COPY CORRECTED BEFORE FIRST PUSH, 2026-08-27: the first draft told her she 'was reading a rolling total'. FALSE, and backwards — viewer.html:7829 records that `week` was the station's own `weeklyrainin`, which RESETS on the week boundary (0.02in read two days after 1.96in fell). She was right that it was not the last seven days; the rolling-week fix came AFTER, because of her. Telling the one person who has ever caught our data being wrong that she had misread a correct number would have been the worst possible sentence to send. The card now says she was right, which is both true and the thing worth telling her. CLASS: expertise, not verdict — the subject is HER rain, not our inference about a plant, and doctrine on a Correctness note is that she is probably right and it is a bug until checked. answerCost=glance: the weather card is the one card she demonstrably opens. ⚠ NO _foldTarget BY DESIGN — it verifies our own display, not canon, so nothing can ever mark it handled. It MUST BE RETIRED BY HAND (read-mom-feedback.py --retire q-rain-byday-check --because ...) or it holds the feedback watermark ceiling open indefinitely, the way q-almanac-name did. ⚠ PLACEMENT IS DELIBERATE: first in file order. outstanding() slices in file order and she has only ever seen position 0 (28 of 28 offers), so approving this makes it the HEAD card and drops q-weed-stiltgrass — 10 offered-days, 0 answers — to position 1, where she has never looked. That is the rotation, done by supply.

questions._note: IA card. ACTIVATED 2026-07-29 — Paul approved the wording and told it to the front ('move this card to the front, but keep a queue of cards'), so MAX_VISIBLE stays 5: he explicitly DECLINED the researcher's drop-to-1 recommendation. It leads the queue on file order alone. Origin: Mom told Paul IN PERSON (relayed 2026-07-29) that tabs across the top would appeal, naming vehicles / equipment / house systems / gardening / wildlife — her words, kept verbatim per CLAUDE.md 'adopt her words, never improve them'. Paul-relayed input is real input (channel doctrine, 2026-07-26). WHY THIS ASK AND NOT A BUILD: telemetry 2026-06-29..07-29 shows her device (d-szqlt0) fired card_expanded only 4x across 15 sessions — she reads the glance and rarely opens the second layer, which is where the radar, the by-day rainfall strip and the Almanac all live. Her tabs request is her own diagnosis of that. Paul's call 2026-07-29: reinforce the existing cards as doors FIRST, and ask her to confirm the category list so the reorganization is built on her answer rather than our guess. CLASS: preference/expertise — she is the sole authority on what she comes here for, so she cannot be wrong. This is deliberately NOT a verdict ask (the '1 answered of 35 offered' that justified this counted PAUL's device — corrected 2026-08-01 to offered 14 → answered 4 over 07-13..08-01; the design call stands on its own reasoning, not on that number). Seeded from HER last input, not from our uncertainty markers — harvest-questions.py could never have produced it. The 'no' path opens correctionPrompt so a category we never thought of can land. The purpose sentence is deliberate (Paul's ask): she is told what her answer will be used for. PLACED FIRST in file order — outstanding() slices the first 5 active confirms in file order (MAX_VISIBLE=5), so an appended card is never served. ⚠ Reflective: no _foldTarget, so it CANNOT self-clear and will hold the feedback watermark until retired by hand (active:false + resolvedAt), per the 2026-07-27 unprobeable rule. RETIRED 2026-08-04 — answered 2026-08-03 7:53 AM ET. Incorporated: her five categories are now the tabs across the top, in her order — Vehicles and Equipment split into their own cards, Household Systems started with the thermostat, and the whole row lifted out of the Reference drawer. Weather added as a sixth, named to her as our call and changeable.

_ordering: ORDERED BY INFORMATION VALUE TO US (Paul, 2026-07-29) — not by area, not by age. outstanding() in viewer.html does .slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE=5) on THIS declaration order, so position is priority and position 6+ renders to nobody. Ranking axis, from the 2026-07-26 audit: an answer that unblocks a BUILD outranks one that fills a canon gap, which outranks a verdict on our own guess. Observation/expertise-class cards lead; verdict-class cards trail until the harvest template is reframed; preference cards last (no canon target, so no fold path and nothing to probe). q-weed-stiltgrass was 6th and therefore served to NOBODY for six days while carrying a photo Mom took — promoted to 2nd. q-strategy-pollinators takes its place out of view; verified unanswered first, so it cannot pin the feedback watermark the way q-almanac-name did. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-08-12 AND THIS UNDERSTATES IT: every momqueue_offered event ever recorded on her device carries position 0 — she has never been offered a card at position 1-4. Since 05db30a (08-03) the queue renders ONE question at a time behind 'Another question ›', and momqueue_tapped is 3 across 60 days. So the effective visible set is 1, not 5, and 'position 6+ renders to nobody' is true of position 1+ as well. Full evidence + the rotation proposal it motivates: .engineering/2026-08-12-card-rotation-proposal.md
